job.title: [Post] SAP POS QA Analyst Job Opening in Ankeny IA
job.company: jaya sree posted on the topic

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & API Integration | 5+ years E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, OMS and PIM/ERP integrations, and end-to-end e-commerce workflows. Proven record of designing data pipelines, executing CI/CD releases, supporting production, and driving UAT and testing activities in agile, international teams. Collaborating closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP POS QA Analyst
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your SAP POS QA initiatives. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API design, OMS integration and end-to-end e-commerce testing.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Designed and delivered OCC REST APIs and data pipelines linking SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, ensuring reliable product and customer data flow for high-volume e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: OMS Experience
bullets.text: Implemented Order Management modules and customized OMS processes in SAP Commerce, supporting order lifecycle testing and validation.

bullets.label: Testing & QA
bullets.text: Led UAT cycles, performed production troubleshooting and executed CI/CD releases, guaranteeing quality and stability of commerce services.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to gather requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. Open to remote or on-site collaboration.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your focus on SAP POS quality assurance because it aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud integrations and end-to-end e-commerce testing. Your commitment to delivering reliable, high-performance POS experiences offers the ideal environment for me to apply my API, OMS and techno-functional expertise while contributing to innovative retail solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud and API integration experience to ensure flawless POS operations and elevate customer experiences at your company.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of API and OMS experience. I’m eager to bring my QA and integration skills to your SAP POS QA Analyst role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP POS QA Analyst – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP POS QA Analyst position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have extensive experience in API integration, OMS processes and QA activities. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.
